_about: The shared contract between the story writer, the validator and the renderer. Positions (x) are 0-100 percent across the stage, left to right.

bedroom.about: dark bedroom: bed, nightstand with a red digital clock, window, door

desk.about: room with a desk, chair, laptop and a warm desk lamp; window behind

kitchen.about: dark kitchen with a fridge that throws light when open, counter

street.about: night street: shopfronts (CAFE, LAUNDRY), lit windows, streetlights

park.about: park at night: wooden bench under a lamp post, trees, fence

cafe.about: cafe interior: counter, menu board, pendant lamp, barista behind counter

gym.about: dark gym with a spotlight, squat rack, dumbbells

hill.about: a long slope rising left to right over a distant city, good for climbing / running metaphors

rooftop.about: rooftop ledge over a city skyline; sky changes with time of day

hallway.about: dark hallway with a door; light spills when it opens

void.about: black emptiness with a single spotlight; inner thoughts, title cards

poses.sit: sits on the set's seat at x (bed, chair, bench, ledge)
poses.phone: looks at a phone held in front of the chest (stand or sit with 'seated': true)
poses.type: sits typing / drawing at the desk
poses.lean: leans toward the target actor, looming (best for the demon)
poses.grab: puts a hand on the target actor's shoulder (best for the demon)

kinds.friend: a friendly character (hat colour sets them apart)
kinds.demon: the black inner voice with a red glow; says cruel lines in red

frames.close: subject's head and shoulders, background blurred
frames.phone: point-of-view phone screen held in hands (needs 'phone')

phone_apps.chat: messages appear; optional typing that can be deleted or sent
phone_apps.call: incoming call screen; can be declined or answered
phone_apps.lock: lock screen with time and notifications
phone_apps.feed: social feed scrolling past other people having fun
